verdict.rationale: Adyen's sessions flow has the merchant server make only a /sessions request while payment handling runs in the client-side application, authenticated by a client key. This implies card data is captured client-side rather than on merchant servers. Adyen also documents tokenizing and encrypting payment credentials, but only for agentic-commerce flows. missing for 10: explicit documentation that raw card data never reaches merchant servers, any statement on PCI DSS scope reduction or SAQ eligibility, documented card tokenization or stored-payment tokens for standard checkout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
